name: Relaybird
summary: A shop automation app with a visual scenario builder, run log, templates, data stores and billing
about: A workflow automation app filled with sample data for a small candle shop. You build scenarios on a canvas by adding steps, wiring them together and setting each one up in a side panel, then run them and watch a pulse travel the wires while the log fills in. Around the builder sit run history, connected apps, templates, small data tables and usage-based billing. Good for automation, integration and no-code products.
how: Open the Builder, click a step in the palette to add it after the selected one, or drag it onto the canvas.
Drag from a coral dot to another step to wire them, or click the dot and then the step; click a wire to remove it.
Click a step to set it up in the side panel: message text, filters, yes or no splits, waits and more.
Press Run once: each step lights up in turn, pulses travel the wires, and the run log shows what happened.
On Scenarios, switch scenarios on or off, run them now, rename, duplicate or delete them.
Open a failed run in Runs to see the step that broke and retry it; connect or test apps under Connections.
Use a template, edit the VIP and discount tables in Data stores, and change plan under Usage and billing.
